# Charter

Norm for new code, humans and agents. Stack rules sit beside this file, loaded on matching files.

- Cite rules by `[ID]`, never by line. IDs never change nor get reused.
- Regimes: **checked** (`charter` fails: after edit, before commit, CI); **ratchet** (debt budget in `charter.toml` only goes down; lower it in the commit reducing the debt); **review** (`charter --unverified`).
- Conflict order: security and data integrity > published API contract > readability > form.
- **[WAIVERS]** Deliberate deviation: `ion repo waive <RULE> --reason "…"` (`waivers.toml`), never silent. Lasts a week, then 1, 3, 6 months per renewal; expired covers nothing. Generated file frozen: `ion repo waive <file>`. Never add or renew without the user's explicit agreement, nor to pass a check. Not waivable: [PERSONAL-DATA], [SECRETS], [NO-COMMIT-ON-MAIN], [LOCKED-DEPENDENCIES].
- **[REPORT-TO-ION-REPO]** Defect in what ion-repo provides (generated file, charter rule, plugin skill or hook, reusable workflow): not fixed here, `ion repo update` would undo it. `/repo:report`: PR if fix clear and local, else issue. Public under the user's account: only with explicit agreement, in English, nothing private.

## Size
- **[FILE-SIZE]** Max 300 lines per file (ratchet). Growing Python module: package whose `__init__.py` re-exports the public API. Exempt: generated files, those `.gitattributes` marks `linguist-generated` (only list).
- **[FUNCTION-SIZE]** One responsibility, max 30 lines (excluding component templates, docstrings); test max 40 if splitting hides the scenario.
- **[ONE-CLASS]** One class per file. Exceptions, still under [FILE-SIZE]: one domain's schemas, one domain's exceptions, one test file's test classes.

## Names
- **[GENERIC-NAMES]** Never `data`, `df`, `res`, `val`, `tmp`, `info`, `obj`, `item`, `result` alone, `x`; say what it holds (`sales_by_month`). Except parameters imposed by a framework signature.
- **[VOCABULARY]** Code in English, domain words; user-read text in project language. URLs are public, may differ from code.
- **[BOOLEANS]** Prefix: `is_`, `has_`, `should_`, `can_` in Python (`is_active`).
- **[CASE]** Classes PascalCase; constants `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE`; Python functions/variables snake_case; files per language convention.

## Values
- **[NO-MAGIC-VALUES]** No business literal (status, role, threshold, delay, price, colour, repeated column name): Python: `enum.StrEnum` or named module constant. Allowed: `0`, `1`, `-1`, `""`, `None`, indexes, test literals.
- **[MONEY]** Integer minor units (`*_cents`) in database, API, front; never float; convert only for display.
- **[TIME-ZONE]** Store instants in UTC. Calendar notions (today, day, month, period bounds) in `Europe/Paris` (`ZoneInfo("Europe/Paris")`), never `.date()` on a UTC instant.

## Personal data, secrets
- **[PERSONAL-DATA]** No personal data (email, name, phone, ID document, full IP) in logs, errors, URLs, cache keys, figures: log `user_id`.
- **[SECRETS]** No secret in code or repo; use environment (`os.environ` read at the edge for the backend). Committed secret is compromised: rotate it.

## Errors, inputs, comments
- **[VALIDATE-AT-BOUNDARIES]** Validate all incoming data (third-party API, source file, `localStorage`, URL parameter, CLI argument) against a schema at run time; static types don't protect it.
- **[EXCEPTIONS]** Never swallow (`except: pass`, `catch {}`); never catch broadly (`except Exception`) without re-raising or logging.
- **[AUDIT-REFERENCES]** Comments state the constraint in present tense, no history, no audit or finding reference ("audit H36", "(CART-06)"); history goes in the commit message (checked).

## Dependencies, tools
- **[UV-PODMAN]** Python via uv (`uv add`, `uv run`, `uv tool install`), never pip, pipx, `requirements.txt`. Containers via podman (`Containerfile`, `compose.yaml`, `podman-compose`), never docker, `Dockerfile`, `docker-compose.yml` (checked).
- **[LOCKED-DEPENDENCIES]** Committed lockfile (`uv.lock`); CI installs frozen, fails on drift.
- **[NEW-DEPENDENCY]** Justify in its commit: maintained (release under a year old), compatible licence, no existing equivalent, name not close to a known package (typosquatting). Upgrades: `ion repo update` (`--major` for majors), one branch per pass; Dependabot only proposes security fixes.
- **[VULNERABILITY-AUDIT]** CI audits each commit; high or critical blocks merge unless a dated, justified waiver covers it.

## AI
- **[AI-ACCOUNTABILITY]** Agent code: same charter and review as human code; whoever merges answers for it.
- **[AI-CONTEXT]** A rule agents keep breaking is badly written: rephrase it where it lives (`/repo:report` for ion-repo's).
- **[AI-CONFIDENTIALITY]** No secret or real personal data pasted to an agent; use test or public data.
- **[AI-FEATURES]** Language-model calls go through a queue, cap cost per call, log model and tokens; generated text never triggers an action without validation (prompt injection).
